The '''''Prosperity''-class Customs Cruiser''' was a [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] built by [[Elrood StarYards, Ltd.]]

==Characteristics==
''Prosperity''-class ships were primarily patrol craft, used for customs inspections, anti-pirate operations and regular planetary defense missions. Armed with six heavy turbolasers, two tractor beam projectors, and protected by [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shielding]], they were however no match against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vessels of the day.

==History==
This class was especially popular within the worlds of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] itself was protected by two dozen ''Prosperities'', one for each starport and the rest remained on patrol and outer orbit customs duty.
